simple.meaning: וָזָר (vâzâr) is a Hebrew word meaning “crime.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.summary: וָזָר (vâzâr) / H2054 is traced through Proverbs 21:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2054. vazar וָזָר adjective criminal, guilty וָזָר֑ אִישׁ דֶּרֶךְ חֲפַכְמַּךְ Prov 21:8 crooked is the way of a guilty man (si vera lectio; text dubious; possible dittograph in וְזַךְ וָזָר ?).
definitions.rootNote: presumed to be from an unused root meaning to bear guilt;

occurrences.englishText: The way of the guilty is devious,
